excerpt: Built for High Resolution, High Efficiency, and High Reliability Seismic Acquisition with Less Operational Cost and Environmental Impact

sections.title: Product Highlights
bullets: All-in-one seismic node with built-in 5Hz/10Hz high-sensitivity geophone, supports external string with KCK adapter;
32-bit Δ-Σ AD converter for high resolution, high dynamic range seismic signal recording;
Highly sensitive GNSS module equipped with active high-gain patch antenna supports deep planting applications (typically 1m buried depth in sand);

Built-in high-precision signal generator supports on-site full signal chain function and performance self-inspection and diagnosis, including acquisition system noise, real-time dynamic range, geophone impedance, natural frequency, sensitivity, damping, distortion, etc.;
P&R (Place & Record) mode for convenient infield deployment;
BLE wireless module together with visual LEDs supports onsite configuration and proximity;
Onsite working status verification after deployment, including battery voltage, environmental temperature, station tilting, environmental signal strength, real-time seismic waveform inspection, etc.;
High-strength engineering plastic enclosure for enhanced waterproof and anti-dropping capability;
Small volume and light weight for convenient field transportation and deployment.
